descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for a SQL Developer with French to join our team.
 Requirements:
 Strong SQL skills and solid experience with Java (17 or newer versions). 
Performance tuning, optimization and profiling.
Hands-on experience with or strong familiarity with technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Oracle EXACC, Spark, Kubernetes, Starburst, Airflow, Python, ELK monitoring, and Docker.
 French language skills .
 Responsibilities:
Work with complex data catalogs involving multiple objects and tables, relationships and cardinalities.
Operate in high-volume data environments: hundreds of millions of rows per day and APIs processing ~2 million calls per hour.
Support demanding production environments with incident-resolution SLAs of less than four hours.
Handle cross-functional requests related to data exposure and accessibility.
Provide technical support to architects, business analysts and developers.
Model publicly exposed data using standards such as Swagger and Avro.
Design internal data tables optimized for efficient read and write operations.
Design, develop and run unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and take part in user acceptance.
Review code from other squad members.
Estimate effort for new projects, enhancements and change requests.
Coordinate deployments across development, QA and production environments.
 AQUASoft is an equal opportunity employer. We invest in people, and we make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, skills, and business needs.
